figure_description: 宋代 poet 与 literary figure / poet of the Southern Song dynasty, known for his patriotic verses and distinctive poetic style
figure_description_en: Southern Song dynasty poet, known for his patriotic verses and distinctive poetic style

personal_background.background: Southern Song dynasty poet, one of the most famous poets in Chinese history, known for his patriotism and family devotion

historical_significance: One of the most influential poets of the Southern Song dynasty, known for his patriotic themes, personal sincerity, and innovative poetic forms that bridged classical and vernacular traditions
key_contributions: Patriotic poetry documenting the Southern Song resistance against Jurchen invasion
Innovative use of everyday language and personal emotion in classical poetry
Preservation of contemporary historical events through verse

thinking_characteristics.systematic_thinking: Structured approach to poetic composition with attention to form, theme, and emotional authenticity
thinking_characteristics.problem_oriented: Focused on expressing national crisis and personal concern through poetic form
thinking_characteristics.dynamic_evaluation: Self-reflective evolution of style across his lifetime
thinking_characteristics.cultural_integration: Blending of orthodox poetic tradition with personal expression

major_achievements.description: Created and popularized the Xiaoling form, a short regulated verse form that became highly influential
major_achievements.impact: Became one of the most widely used poetic forms in later Chinese poetry

major_achievements.description: Produced extensive body of poetry documenting the Southern Song resistance and personal experiences of national crisis
major_achievements.impact: Established poetic tradition of political engagement and national responsibility

major_achievements.description: Pioneered the use of personal emotion, family themes, and everyday experience as poetic subjects
major_achievements.impact: Opened new possibilities for classical poetry to express personal and domestic themes

influences: Classical Tang and Song poetic traditions
intellectual_heritage.legacy: One of the most frequently anthologized poets in Chinese literary history; his work remains a cornerstone of Song poetry study

challenges: Jurchen invasion and loss of northern China
Preservation of Song culture under duress
opportunities: Development of new poetic forms and expressions

current_applications: Study of Song dynasty poetry and literary history
Analysis of political engagement in classical art
lessons_learned: The power of personal expression within traditional forms
How poetry can document and respond to historical crisis
The balance between personal emotion and cultural tradition

data_sources: Historical records of the Southern Song dynasty
Literary criticism and commentary through the centuries
